target.statement: Weighted accuracy of the parameter-free sorted-conditional bz2 compression baseline on the 102-pair Tübingen CEP set (forced decision, no tuning) = 74.7%
target.dataset: Tübingen Cause-Effect Pairs (CEP), 102 pairs with scalar cause/effect and >=50 samples, official pairmeta.txt weights

compute.basis: The baseline is a single pure-Python bz2 function with zero fitted parameters; the paper reports ~1 ms per pair (0.20 s aggregate for 100 pairs), so the only real cost is downloading the CEP data and writing the ~50-line scorer.

blockers: Code link is a bare project URL (stateoftheart.nl/causal) with no repository/DOI in the PDF, so the released scorer may not be directly retrievable
Exact 102-pair subset and weighting must be reconstructed from pairmeta.txt (paper says 102 pairs; literature varies 95-108)
title: One Ruler: A Same-Hands Re-Evaluation of Bivariate Causal Direction on Tuebingen, with a Parameter-Free Compression Baseline
